All 188 case-decision hashes and all 138 selected payload hashes were independently rebound to the published core; the sealed scientific review remains needs_curation. This comment records bounded follow-up before author correction, not approval or application.

Exact W05-CR-F08 extension to #1229. Three MgSO2 formulas and the Nicotinate protonation alias conflict with their owners. Hydration-omitting generic magnesium-sulfate names require exact historical/source form assessment; formula plausibility is not universal typo evidence. Preserve proven damaged raw labels only where the exact source bridge supports them. Closed #878 concerns a different hydrate-name routing defect and does not settle all these literals.
